beats.text: The hospital was burning, and John went in.
Fire had broken out in the great hospital of Granada.
beats.scene: Night: a large sixteenth-century stone hospital with arched windows burning, flames pouring from upper windows and the roof, thick smoke rolling into a stormy sky, hard orange-less black-and-white firelight on the cobbled square in front; far below, tiny dark figures hurrying, seen from far behind. Skewed angular architecture, no faces.

beats.text: He carried the sick out, one by one.
Later, he plunged into a river to save a drowning young man.

beats.scene: A wide dark river at dusk under a heavy sky, calm rippled water spreading in rings where something has gone under, a worn dark cloak and a pair of boots left on the empty muddy bank in the foreground, bare willows, mist on the far shore. No people.

beats.text: He fell ill, and died on the eighth of March, 1550: his fifty-fifth birthday.
In 1690, the Church declared him a saint, patron of hospitals and the sick.
beats.scene: A long bare whitewashed hospital ward of sixteenth-century Granada at night seen down its length: two rows of empty straw pallets, a single candle burning on a small wooden table at the far end beneath a plain wooden crucifix, a shaft of soft light from a high window, mist on the floor. No people.

beats.text: Saint John of God, pray for us.
beats.scene: A plain wooden cross on a bare stone wall with one candle burning below it, hard side light, deep black shadows, a thin rising line of candle smoke. No people.
